title: 주광 최초 진입의 명시 차수 조회

actions.name: ENTRY
actions.sideEffect: Only local year/week form. Week selection uses 56x44px increment/decrement buttons, preserves direct input and ArrowUp/Down, clamps native step to1..53 without changing year; blank starts at1. Heavy workspace remains unmounted, no weekday calendar/default/customer/distribution/template/polling requests until submit.

actions.name: EXPLICIT_QUERY
actions.sideEffect: Valid year2000..2200 + majorWeek01..53 initializes existing workspace. Skip defaultNext so explicit selection cannot be overwritten. All existing read/write/refresh/draft/print policies retained after query.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/43 and2026/43 distinct;2026/53 and2027/01 retain explicit year. Empty,zero,false,malformed selection never mounts workspace.

dnspyEvidence.reason: UI mount timing only; native SQL and shared ledger behavior unchanged. Current SELECT probe rerun before implementation.

steppingRegression: 44 down =>43, then43 up=>44. Use React state arithmetic, preserving the visible numeric input and falling back to state if blur temporarily empties the DOM. Bounds1..53, no year change.
